content.title: Welcome to Claim’s Mouth!
content.body: Ho there, traveler! I’m Brewmaster Alehart, keeper of taps and threads. Step into Claim’s Mouth and say hello below. Choose your guild vibe—Brassbound (tinkerers), Emberforge (fighters), or Ordinate (planners). Reaction-roles are optional if the kegs are set; no pressure. Grab a stool, meet the crew, and ask for a tour if you fancy.

content.title: House Rules — The Three‑Wide Law
content.body:
- Be kind; lift each other’s craft.
- Actionable critique: goal, issue, suggestion.
- Spoilers in threads; tag builds and plot.
- No NSFW, slurs, or harassment.
- Keep lanes clear: no dogpiles; let mods steer.
- Use channels, not unsolicited DMs. Mods uphold a gentle nudge → warn → mute → ban.

content.title: How to Pitch In
content.body: Want to lend a hand? Drop shiny shots in #screenshots, ideas in #feedback-mine (use the template), and bugs in #bug-reports. Lore banter lives in #lore-codex. First step: say hello, then share a screenshot or answer the weekly tavern poll. Small swings deepen the mine!

content.title: Sprint 1 — Brass Rims and First Lamps
content.body:
• Single level: Claim’s Mouth upper shafts
• Foes: goblin scout + burrower
• Crafting: 3 starter recipes
• Hub: Tavern for quests/loadout
Track progress in the weekly #build-in-public thread and the midweek Clip & Peek. Want in on tests? Opt in via #playtest-queue.

content.title: Feedback & Playtests — 48h Ack
content.body: Use our intake templates: Feature Card (what/why), UX Note (flow/pain), and Balance Nudge (numbers/feel). We acknowledge within 48h and set disposition within 7d. Triage updates land in #announcements summaries and a #dev-cabinet note. See the pinned templates to paste, then post in #feedback-mine.
